lines.text: What do you do in your free time?
lines.speaker: Ada

lines.text: I take photos, mostly on weekends.
lines.speaker: Jun

lines.text: What do you take photos of?
lines.speaker: Ada

lines.text: Old buildings. I go out early on Sundays.
lines.speaker: Jun

lines.text: Not always. I sometimes go with my cousin.
lines.speaker: Jun

lines.text: That sounds fun. I draw in my free time.
lines.speaker: Ada

lines.text: What do you like to draw?
lines.speaker: Jun
